card: ROLE: Supreme visible techno-religious authority within the imperial hierarchy.
ROLE: Central officiant for the empire's highest public honors, including the pluri-galactic medallion.
TRAIT: His office joins temple-bank wealth, religious title, imperial logistics, senate spectacle, and medallion ceremony into one visible apparatus.
TRAIT: Commands or authorizes projects large enough to mobilize imperial commerce and planetary-scale marble extraction.
TRAIT: Early presence is mediated through commissions, merchants, and institutional projects before later ceremony evidence shows him in person.
TRAIT: Important enough that his death is named again as a notable casualty rather than passing into background chaos.
RELATIONSHIP: Imperial Merchants Guild: commissions or employs the guild's ship and crew for marble acquisition tied to a new temple-bank.
RELATIONSHIP: steelhead__late (Steelhead): abducted him from the Techno-Techno stronghold and brought him to Philodendra.
RELATIONSHIP: aghora (Aghora): publicly confers the pluri-galactic medallion on Aghora before the galactic senate.
RELATIONSHIP: deyanira (Deyanira): attacks and devours him alive during the award ceremony.
VOICE: Has no substantive captured dialogue; make him ceremonial, institutional, and mediated unless a scene specifically gives him speech.
INSTRUCTION: Before Aghora's award ceremony, make his power procedural and architectural: orders, titles, commissions, medallions, halls, crowds, and institutional gravity.
INSTRUCTION: Keep him to office, ceremony, extraction power, abduction, and public death; do not invent private theology, strategy, or inner life.
BOUNDARY: Do not reveal his fate before the ceremony's violence becomes active in sequence.
phase_boundary_note: Merged same-persona spelling and title variants only; no separate phase split is encoded. Treat early references as mediated institutional presence and later records as the same office-holder appearing in abduction and ceremony evidence.
source_strategy: Source-bounded to four thin Technopope records plus directly verified page summaries for Marmola marble requisition, Aghora's medallion ceremony, and Deyanira's attack. Wiki and link matrix were used only for orientation; no wiki-only biography or interior motive was added.
